item.summary: Bitcoin Suisse (Europe), the EU arm of the Swiss crypto company Bitcoin Suisse, received a MiCA licence in June 2026, which allows it to offer crypto-asset services in the European Economic Area. According to a LinkedIn post by the company's Nordic general manager, cited by Kaupr, it plans to launch in the Nordic countries in early November, ahead of an event in Stockholm on 19 November.
